lang.label: Language
hero.title: The AI agent that works with your permission
hero.lead: Talks in your language, runs tools and works on your devices — asking your permission at every sensitive step. Install it like an app on any phone.
flow.title: How the agent works
flow.s1d: Give a task in your language
feat.council_d: Answers drawing on several free models — automatic fallback if one fails.
feat.tools_d: Browse, search, shell, files — with a step log and Approve cards.
feat.phone_d: PWA — add to your home screen like an app. Android and iOS Safari.
feat.control_d: No sending, payments or device actions without permission. Everything is audit-logged.
login.note: Gmail, Yahoo, Proton — any email works. Your account is created automatically.
login.err_send: Couldn’t send the code — see below
login.sent: Code sent — check your inbox (and spam).
app.ph_agent: Give the agent a task (e.g. open this site and summarize)...
app.hint: Bangla Bhai can make mistakes. Verify important information.
app.welcome_sub: What can I do today? Chat, or turn on 🤖 Agent to give me a task — I’ll ask your permission at every step.
app.agent_on: 🤖 Agent mode: it will ask before every action
sug.agent_q: Agent: check how much disk space is free on the box with `duf`
sug.write_q: Write an engaging post for my Facebook page
sug.earn_q: Give me 3 realistic ways to earn online for free
sug.code_q: Write the code for a simple HTML landing page
sug.tr_q: Translate into Bangla: I am starting a new business
set.title: ⚙️ Settings
set.persona_ph: e.g. keep answers short, give examples...
set.memory_notes: Things to remember (used in every chat when memory is on)
set.perm_d: Separate permission for each device and capability. Nothing runs secretly; everything is audit-logged.
pricing.title: Pricing (placeholder)
pricing.lead: Everything is free during beta. Plans will be finalized at cloud launch — no charges yet.
pricing.free_d: Email login, chat, council, basic agent. Rate limits apply.
pricing.pro_d: More quota, device link, voice, priority support. Price announced later.
pricing.team_d: Multi-user workspace, audit export, your own brand. Email us if interested.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: 22 October 2026 · Bangla Bhai · Royal Universe
privacy.store2: Your chats and settings (separate per account)
privacy.store3: Audit log of permissions and agent actions
privacy.not1: Send messages, pay or change accounts without permission
privacy.not2: Secretly use the camera, mic or screen
privacy.not3: Show OTPs or passwords in chat
privacy.models_p: Answers may be generated via APIs such as Groq, Google Gemini or OpenRouter — their own policies apply.
privacy.rights_p: You can export and delete your data in the app. The owner account keeps administrative control.
api.title: Bangla Bhai API (session cookie)
api.lead: All /bb/api/* routes require a logged-in session (email OTP or owner password).
api.more: Agent tools & permission caps: see PLAN.md and /bb/link/README.md
err.no_model: Sorry {name}, no model is responding right now. Please try again shortly.
